density.description: Operational screens favor compact, scannable information over marketing layout.
density.card_radius: 0px unless a local template adds a small radius

typography.letter_spacing: 0 for normal text; small uppercase eyebrows may use positive spacing

standard.action_depth: gradient, inset highlight, soft lower shadow

patterns.hero: Work header with eyebrow, h1, optional help popover, and short context only.
patterns.panel: Full-width operational section; not nested decorative cards.
patterns.help_popover: Compact ? button; details hidden until requested.
patterns.action_menu: Secondary and rare actions are collapsed in details/summary menus.
patterns.danger_action: Destructive actions use danger styling plus confirmation.
patterns.tables_and_cards: Use cards for repeated entities and tables for dense comparison.
